name: Avaati Vya
description: An inventor whose prototype aether refiner is at the Museum of Invention.

timeline.summary: Avaati Vya cracks the aether code, developing a refinement process that separates aether's energy-rich part from its volatile part.
timeline.quote: Six decades ago, the world-renowned aetherologist Avaati Vya cracked the aether code.

pages_say.description: A world-renowned aetherologist who cracked the aether code six decades ago by developing the refinement process.
An inventor whose prototype aether refiner is at the Museum of Invention.
